In order to support lifting the grace period early
nfsdcltrack what sort of client the ""create"" upcall is for. We can't
reliably tell if a v4.0 client has completed reclaiming
lift the grace period once all the v4.1+ clients have issued a
RECLAIM_COMPLETE and if there are no v4.0 clients.

column2: in order to lift the grace period
column3: we have to tell userland when

column1: the grace period started so that it can tell whether a RECLAIM_COMPLETE
has been issued for each client since then.
Since this is all optional info
column2: we pass it along in environment

column1: variables to the ""init"" and ""create"" upcalls. By doing this
need to revise the upcall format. The UMH upcall can simply make use of
this info if it happens to be present. If it's not then it can just
avoid lifting the grace period early.
